params.name: namespaceName
params.description: The Log Analytics namespace used for the request. The namespace can be obtained by running 'oci os ns get'

params.name: uploadName
params.description: The name of the upload. This can be considered as a container name where different kind of logs will be collected and searched together. This upload name/id can further be used for retrieving the details of the upload, including its status or deleting the upload.

params.name: logSourceName
params.description: Name of the log source that will be used to process the files being uploaded.

params.name: entityId
params.description: The entity OCID.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone to be used when processing log entries whose timestamps do not include an explicit timezone. When this property is not specified, the timezone of the entity specified is used. If the entity is also not specified or do not have a valid timezone then UTC is used

params.name: charEncoding
params.description:
Character encoding to be used to detect the encoding type of file(s) being uploaded.
When this property is not specified, system detected character encoding will be used.

params.name: dateFormat
params.description: This property is used to specify the format of the date. This is to be used for ambiguous dates like 12/11/10. This property can take any of the following values -  MONTH_DAY_YEAR, DAY_MONTH_YEAR, YEAR_MONTH_DAY, MONTH_DAY, DAY_MONTH.

params.name: dateYear
params.description: Used to indicate the year where the log entries timestamp do not mention year (Ex: Nov  8 20:45:56).

params.name: invalidateCache
params.description: This property can be used to reset configuration cache in case of an issue with the upload.

params.name: filename
params.description: The name of the file being uploaded. The extension of the filename part will be used to detect the type of file (like zip, tar).

params.name: logSet
params.description: The log set that gets associated with the uploaded logs.

info.name: List and sort warnings based on specified criteria.

params.name: namespaceName
params.description: The Log Analytics namespace used for the request. The namespace can be obtained by running 'oci os ns get'

params.name: warningState
params.description:
The warning state used for filtering.  A value of SUPPRESSED will return only
suppressed warnings, a value of UNSUPPRESSED will return only unsuppressed
warnings, and a value of ALL will return all warnings regardless of their
suppression state.  Default is UNSUPPRESSED.

params.name: sourceName
params.description: The source name.

params.name: sourcePattern
params.description:
The source pattern used for filtering.  Only warnings associated with a source with the
specified pattern will be returned.

params.name: warningMessage
params.description: warning message query parameter

params.name: entityName
params.description: The entity name used for filtering.

params.name: entityType
params.description:
The entity type used for filtering.  Only associations on an entity with the
specified type will be returned.

params.name: warningType
params.description: The warning type query parameter.

params.name: isNoSource
params.description:
A flag indicating whether to filter warnings based on source display name or on warning level.
A value of true will filter based on warning level (rule, source, or pattern), while a
value of false will filter based on source display name.

params.name: startTime
params.description: The warning start date query parameter.

params.name: endTime
params.description: The warning end date query parameter.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The attribute used to sort the returned warnings

items.docs: Returns a list of collection warnings, containing detailed information about them. You may limit the number of results, provide sorting order, and filter by information such as start time, end time, warning type, warning state, source name, source pattern and entity name.
